title: SrdSpellData
description: `data` payload of a generated SRD 5.2.1 spell compendium entry (packs/spells.json). Structured fields (attackType, saveAbility, damage, healDice, area) are present only when the rules text states them; the description stays authoritative. Units: feet for areas, GP for material costs.

classes.description: Class spell lists, sorted. Empty for spells no class learns directly.

castingTime.description: 1 action, 1 bonus action, 1 reaction, 1 minute, 10 minutes or 1 hour.

range.description: Range as printed (Self, Touch, 60 feet, 1 mile, Sight, Unlimited).

duration.description: Duration as printed; concentration spells read 'Concentration, up to <duration>'.

attackType.description: Kind of spell attack roll the spell makes; absent when it makes none.

saveAbility.description: First saving throw named by the rules text.

damageDice.description: First damage roll; legacy single-roll field kept for the curated spell shape.

damage.description: Every distinct typed damage roll named by the rules text, in order (may include alternatives such as Spirit Guardians' Radiant or Necrotic).

damageResolution.description: Present only on damaging spells with neither attack roll nor saving throw: automatic hits (Magic Missile), riders added to a weapon hit (Hex, Divine Smite), or damage from a later trigger or to the caster, resolved by the table (Spike Growth, Teleport).

damageCombination.description: How several damage parts combine at once: all of them (Flame Strike) or one chosen type (Spirit Guardians). Absent: only the first part is dealt at once, later parts are timed or conditional (Acid Arrow).

instances.description: Repeated beams, darts or rays, each resolved on its own (Eldritch Blast, Magic Missile, Scorching Ray).

count.description: Instances at the spell's level (character level 1 for a cantrip).

perSlotLevel.description: Extra instances per slot level above the spell's level.

cantripScaling.description: Multiply count by the cantrip damage tier (x2 at character level 5, x3 at 11, x4 at 17).

higherLevel.description: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot or Cantrip Upgrade text.
